title: ElectroChemLLM: A Multimodal LLM Pipeline for High-Fidelity Electrochemical Informatics
abstract: arXiv:2611.00638v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electrochemistry is central to solving many modern-day challenges, including energy storage systems for a sustainable future, and its advancement relies heavily on the data from past findings. Existing automated pipelines are limited by text-only architectures, context fragmentation, and numerical hallucinations - collectively preventing accurate, large-scale curation of property databases. We introduce ElectrochemLLM, a multimodal information extraction pipeline that jointly identifies structured electrochemical records encompassing electrolyte compositions, electrode materials, cell configurations, and their measured physicochemical properties from unstructured scientific PDFs at scale. By combining hybrid document parsing with vision-capable LLM orchestration, the pipeline extracts verifiable, structured data across text, tables, and figures. Evaluated on the battery-electrolyte subset of our manually annotated benchmark of 232 papers

translated_title: ElectroChemLLM：面向高保真电化学信息学的多模态大语言模型流水线
translated_abstract: 电化学是解决诸多当代挑战的核心，包括面向可持续未来的储能系统，而其进展高度依赖于以往研究成果中的数据。现有的自动化流水线受限于纯文本架构、上下文碎片化和数值幻觉，这些问题共同阻碍了性质数据库的精确、大规模整理。我们提出了 ElectroChemLLM——一个多模态信息提取流水线，能够从非结构化的科学 PDF 文献中大规模地联合识别结构化电化学记录，涵盖电解液成分、电极材料、电池构型及其测得的物理化学性质。通过将混合文档解析与具备视觉能力的大语言模型编排相结合，该流水线可从文本、表格和图表中提取可验证的结构化数据。该流水线在我们人工标注的 232 篇论文基准数据集的电池电解液子集上进行了评估。
tldr: 提出多模态大语言模型流水线 ElectroChemLLM，通过混合文档解析与视觉 LLM 编排相结合，从科学 PDF 中大规模提取涵盖电解液成分、电极材料、电池构型及物化性质的可验证结构化电化学数据，克服了纯文本架构、上下文碎片化与数值幻觉的局限。
